cross.def: to go from one side to the other
cross.ex: We cross the bridge to the park.

describe.def: to tell what something is like

despite.ex: We played outside despite the clouds.

female.def: a girl or woman, or an animal that can have babies or lay eggs
female.ex: The female hen laid an egg.

focus.def: to give all your attention to one thing
focus.ex: Focus on the page and read.

hi.def: a friendly word you say when you meet someone

husband.def: the man someone is married to
husband.ex: The husband waved from the window.

ice.def: frozen water that is hard and cold
ice.ex: We put ice in the juice.

individual.ex: Each individual has a different smile.

message.def: words sent from one person to another
message.ex: I sent a message to my friend.

mile.def: a length used to measure how far something is
mile.ex: We walked one mile to the park.

particular.def: one special thing and not any other
particular.ex: I like this particular shell the best.

previous.ex: The previous page had a picture of a fish.

section.def: one part of a bigger thing
section.ex: The fish section of the library is my favorite.

sort.def: to put things in groups that are alike

speed.ex: The speed of the train was slow.

travel.def: to go from one place to another far away
travel.ex: We travel to Korea by plane.

contact.def: to speak or write to someone
contact.ex: I will contact my friend by phone.

fair.ex: It is fair to take turns.

foot.def: the part of the body at the end of your leg
foot.ex: I hurt my foot, so I rested.

link.def: a piece that joins two things, or a word you click on a screen
link.ex: Click the link to see the video.

positive.def: thinking about the good side of things
positive.ex: She has a positive way of seeing things.

sale.def: a time when things cost less money
sale.ex: The shop has a sale on shoes.

throughout.def: in every part of a place or time

tour.def: a trip to see many places
tour.ex: We took a tour of the farm.

welcome.def: a friendly word you say when someone arrives

absolutely.ex: It is absolutely quiet in the library.

additional.def: more than what is already there
additional.ex: We need additional chairs for the guests.

beyond.def: on the far side of something
beyond.ex: The beach is beyond the hill.

condition.ex: The book is in good condition.

minute.def: a length of time of sixty seconds

nature.def: all the plants, animals and land that people did not make
nature.ex: We walk in nature on weekends.

quick.def: doing something in a short time

sell.def: to give something to someone for money
sell.ex: The farmer will sell apples at the market.

significant.def: big enough to matter, or very important
significant.ex: A significant amount of rain fell last night.

unless.def: a word that means if not
unless.ex: We will go unless it rains.

agree.def: to think the same as someone else
agree.ex: I agree that the beach is fun.

canada.def: a big country in North America
canada.ex: Canada has many lakes and forests.

computer.def: a machine that stores and shows information
computer.ex: I use the computer to learn words.

construction.def: the building of something like a house or a bridge
construction.ex: The construction of the new school is almost done.

episode.def: one part of a show that has many parts
episode.ex: We watched one episode of our favorite show.

income.def: the money a person gets from work

justice.def: treating people in a fair way
justice.ex: The judge wants justice for all.

manager.def: a person who is in charge of a shop or team
manager.ex: The manager of the shop was kind.

movement.ex: The movement of the waves is calm.

photo.def: a picture taken with a camera
photo.ex: We took a photo of the beach.

safety.ex: Wear a helmet for your safety.

scene.def: a place where something happens, or a part of a play or film
scene.ex: The sunset scene on the beach was lovely.

statement.ex: The teacher made a statement about the trip.

sun.def: the bright star that gives us light and heat

ability.ex: She has the ability to swim far.

announce.def: to tell something to many people
announce.ex: The teacher will announce the winners.

coach.def: a person who trains a team or a player
coach.ex: The coach showed us how to kick the ball.

collection.def: a group of things gathered together
collection.ex: I have a collection of shells.

definitely.def: a word that means for sure, with no doubt
definitely.ex: I will definitely come to your party.

friday.ex: We have art class on Friday.

gun.def: a tool that shoots small pieces of metal and can hurt people
gun.ex: A water gun is fun in summer.

heavy.def: hard to lift because it weighs a lot

knowledge.ex: Books give us knowledge about the world.

particularly.def: a word that means more than is usual
particularly.ex: The sea is particularly calm today.

search.ex: We search the beach for shells.

subject.def: what a lesson or a talk is about

wide.def: big from one side to the other

wow.def: a word you say when you are very surprised

author.ex: The author wrote a book about a turtle.

centre.ex: The centre of the cake has a cherry.

claim.def: to say that something is true or is yours
claim.ex: I claim this blue coat as mine.

develop.ex: A tadpole will develop into a frog.

fear.def: the feeling you get when something seems dangerous
fear.ex: She felt no fear on the slide.

fit.def: to be the right size and shape

generally.ex: Birds generally sing in the morning.

german.def: the language people speak in a country in Europe

global.ex: The globe shows a global map.

hotel.def: a building where people pay to sleep for a few nights
hotel.ex: We stayed at a hotel by the sea.

judge.def: a person who decides who wins or what is fair
judge.ex: The judge gave the winner a ribbon.

lady.def: a polite word for a woman

leader.def: a person who goes first or is in charge of a group
leader.ex: The leader of the line is Sam.

letter.def: a written message on paper that you send
letter.ex: I wrote a letter to Grandma.

letter.def: a sign like A or B that stands for a sound
letter.ex: The first letter of my name is M.

nobody.ex: Nobody was in the park early.

opportunity.def: a good chance to do something
opportunity.ex: I had an opportunity to pet a puppy.

plus.def: a word that means and also

regular.def: the same each time or happening at the same times

secretary.def: a person who helps with office work

sister.def: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
sister.ex: My sister and I play on the beach.

unit.ex: Our book has a unit about the sea.

worker.def: a person who does a job
worker.ex: The worker planted flowers in the park.

annual.ex: We go to the annual fair.

anymore.ex: The pond does not freeze anymore.

bar.def: a long piece of something hard, like soap or chocolate
bar.ex: I ate a bar of chocolate.

battle.ex: The old story tells of a battle long ago.

brain.def: the part inside your head that helps you think

contract.def: a paper that says what people agree to do
contract.ex: The two people signed a contract.

degree.def: a unit used to measure how hot or cold something is

feature.ex: A big window is a feature of the room.

finish.def: to come to the end of something
finish.ex: I finish my homework before dinner.

floor.def: the part of a room that you walk on
floor.ex: The cat sleeps on the floor.

france.def: a country in Europe where people speak French
france.ex: We saw a picture of France.

grow.def: to get bigger or to become taller

hurt.def: to cause pain to a body
hurt.ex: I hurt my finger on the door.

insurance.def: money paid to help when something is lost or broken
insurance.ex: Insurance helped fix the old car.

majority.def: more than half of a group
majority.ex: The majority of the class likes apples.

opinion.ex: In my opinion, the soup is tasty.

physical.def: about the body and not the mind

reach.def: to get to a place, or to stretch out to touch something
reach.ex: We reach the beach by noon.

seriously.def: in a careful way, not joking
seriously.ex: She listened seriously to the rules.

sport.def: a game that makes your body move, like soccer

stupid.def: an unkind word for something not smart, so we do not say it to people
stupid.ex: It is not kind to call a friend stupid.

successful.def: having done what you wanted to do

active.ex: The active puppy ran in circles.

administration.def: the people who run a school or a place
administration.ex: The school administration planned the trip.

approach.ex: The deer will approach the pond.

australian.ex: The Australian animal in the book was a koala.

cancer.def: a sickness where some cells in the body grow in a wrong way
cancer.ex: The doctor helps people who have cancer.

civil.ex: We had a civil talk about the game.

dance.def: to move your body to music
dance.ex: We dance to a happy song.

defense.def: something that keeps you safe from harm
defense.ex: A shell is the turtle's defense.

direction.def: the way something goes or faces
direction.ex: The bird flew in that direction.

independent.def: able to do things without help
independent.ex: She is independent and ties her own shoes.

master.def: a person who is very good at something
master.ex: The master baker made a tasty pie.
